source.label: {kind}:
area.hint: Tap a spot on the model to see what lies under it.
area.title: Under this spot, from the surface inwards
area.throughTitle: Over and under {name}, seen from here
area.note: This lists what the model has under the spot. It does not say what causes a symptom.
area.noSkin: The model has no skin or fat, so depth starts at the outermost muscle or bone.
info.overUnder: See what lies over and under it
mode.label: What to explore
movement.exercisesPending: Exercises are waiting for a physiotherapist's review.
movement.effortNote: Muscles shown as working are the ones that produce or control this phase.
movement.none: There is no checked information for this movement yet.
movement.pending: More information for this movement is waiting for a physiotherapist's review.
movement.hiddenNote: Muscles and soft tissue that are not involved are hidden while a movement is picked.
notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.disclaimer: This notebook is for your own notes. It is not a diagnosis and not medical advice. If you are worried, talk to a qualified health professional.
notebook.private: Your notes stay in this browser on this device. They are never sent anywhere.
notebook.backupHint: Some phones delete stored notes after a while without use. Save a backup file now and then.
notebook.unavailable: This browser does not let the app store notes, for example in a private window. The rest of the app works as usual.
notebook.empty: No notes yet. Pick a movement in the Movements tab and log how it feels.
notebook.unknown: a movement this version does not know
notebook.candidate: {name}: loaded in {painful} of {total} movements you marked as hurting, and in none you marked as fine
notebook.needPainful: Log at least one movement that hurts to see structures to look into.
notebook.needFine: Log movements that feel fine too. They narrow this list down.
notebook.noRows: There is no checked movement information for the movements you logged yet.
notebook.incomplete: Some movement information is still waiting for review, so this list may be incomplete.
notebook.ruledOut: Also loaded by movements that feel fine: {names}
notebook.loadError.too-large: That file is too large to be a notebook backup.
notebook.loadError.not-json: That file is not a notebook backup.
notebook.loadError.wrong-format: That file is not a notebook backup.
notebook.loadError.newer-version: That backup was made by a newer version of anatoMe.
notebook.loadError.bad-entry: That backup is damaged, so nothing was loaded.
summary.title: anatoMe notebook summary
summary.basis: The list of structures uses only movement information that a physiotherapist has checked. Sources are shown in the app.
